title: DevOps Engineering (81 h)
description:
In-company training, on-site or remote. Eligible for CNFCPP (TFP) refund.

Participants can take an application from commit to production through an automated pipeline with tests, quality gates, versioned artifacts, infrastructure as code, and monitoring with alerts.

Programme (81 h: 72 h of modules + 9 h buffer for catch-up, revision and extra lab time)
01 DevOps Culture & Collaboration (9 h): DevOps principles, Git and team workflows
02 Continuous Integration & Delivery (24 h): Jenkins, automated tests, SonarQube, Nexus, deployment strategies, GitHub Actions
03 Infrastructure as Code (24 h): Terraform provisioning on AWS, Ansible configuration management
04 Observability (6 h): Prometheus metrics and alerts, Grafana dashboards and Loki logs
Final Project (9 h): End-to-end delivery chain, presented to the group

For: Developers, system administrators and IT engineers moving into DevOps roles
Prerequisites: Linux command line and Bash (course: Linux & Bash Scripting); Docker and Kubernetes basics (course: Docker & Kubernetes). This course builds on Docker & Kubernetes and does not repeat it.
Format: Short lectures followed by guided labs; one application carried through every phase
Assessment: A lab validated at the end of each phase and a final project presented to the group; certificate of completion for participants who complete both

Prepares the core topics of HashiCorp Terraform Associate, GitHub Actions and LPI DevOps Tools Engineer 2.0.

Price on quote. Send a message with your team size and preferred dates.

Trainer: Mohamed Aziz BEN HAHA, PhD, Cloud & DevOps engineer (CKA, AWS)
